018/*******
019 * <p> Title: LessonTestingAutomation Class. </p>
020 * <p>Runs contributor CRUD, validation, list, subset, and restart tests through
021 * the real JavaFX controller and H2 database. Case numbers correspond to the
022 * requirements matrix in ContributorTests_Javadocs/RequirementsToTests.md.</p>
023 * <p>Run twice in separate JVMs: the first execution writes a restart marker;
024 * the second verifies persistence and removes that marker. Set
025 * {@code contributor.test.home} to an isolated directory and optionally set
026 * {@code contributor.test.evidence} to save PNG snapshots. Exit status is zero
027 * only when every assertion in that execution passes. UI actions run on the
028 * JavaFX Application Thread; this is not a headless test.</p>
029 * <p>Task 3 is checked through entity validation, persistent lesson CRUD, and
030 * collection operations. Task 4 is checked through the real MVC form, dialogs,
031 * buttons, and subset display. As in PasswordEvaluationTestingAutomation,
032 * each assertion reports its expected behavior and a pass/fail counter.</p>
033 * @author Ahmad El-Merhaby
034 */
035
036public class LessonTestingAutomation {
037
038        /** Number of successful assertions in this JVM, following the Foundations testbed. */
039        static int numPassed = 0;
040        /** Number of failed assertions or unexpected test errors in this JVM. */
041        static int numFailed = 0;
042        /** IDs shared between separate executions to establish real disk persistence. */
043        private static File restartFile;
044        /** Text read from the real dialog rather than inferred from a validation method. */
045        private static String actualError;
046        /** Contributor identity used to isolate the fixture's owner-filtered list. */
047        private static int testOwnerId;
048        /** Optional output directory for visible application evidence. */
049        private static Path evidenceDirectory;
050        /** Prevents later dialogs from overwriting this execution's first error screenshot. */
051        private static boolean errorCaptured;
052
053        /** Creates a runner; initialization happens in {@link #start(Stage)}. */
054        public LessonTestingAutomation() { }
055        private static final String titleError = "Enter a title that is between 1-100 characters";
056        private static final String problemError = "Enter a problem that is between 1-2000 characters";
057        private static final String solutionError = "Enter a solution that is between 1-2000 characters";
058        private static final String experienceError = "Experience has max 2000 characters";
059        private static final String selectionError = "Select a lesson that exists";
060        private static final String title = "Making 4 CRUD Diagrams";
061        private static final String problem = "The homework asks for four diagrams with two main data classes.";
062        private static final String solution = "Make a separate diagram for Create, Read, Update, and Delete.";
063        private static final String experience = "A team member organized the classes in Astah in 20 minutes.";
064
065        /**
066         * Starts JavaFX after isolating H2 storage from normal application data.
067         * @param args unused command-line arguments; configuration uses system properties
068         */
069        public static void main(String[] args) {
070                // For H2 it uses user.home. which is a separate folder keeps tests away from real accounts/lessons
071                File testFolder = new File(System.getProperty("contributor.test.home",
072                                new File(System.getProperty("user.home"), "HW2-Test-Database").getPath()));
073                if (!testFolder.isDirectory() && !testFolder.mkdirs()) {
074                        System.out.println("Could not create the test database folder.");
075                        System.exit(1);
076                }
077                System.setProperty("user.home", testFolder.getAbsolutePath());
078                String evidence = System.getProperty("contributor.test.evidence");
079                if (evidence != null) evidenceDirectory = Path.of(evidence);
080                restartFile = new File(testFolder, "restart-test.txt");
081                Platform.startup(() -> new LessonTestingAutomation().start(new Stage()));
082        }
083        /**
084         * Opens the real lesson view and schedules the appropriate test phase.
085         * @param stage the JavaFX stage used by the tests
086         */
087        public void start(Stage stage) {
088                try {
089                        FoundationsMain.database.connectToDatabase();
090                        User user = new User("HW2 Tests", "", "", "", "", "", "", false, false, false, 0);
091                        testOwnerId = user.getUserId();
092                        stage.setScene(new javafx.scene.Scene(new javafx.scene.layout.Pane(), 800, 600));
093                        stage.setTitle("Contributor test home");
094                        ViewLessons.displayLessons(stage, user);
095                        // Run after JavaFX starts so error dialogs can be opened and checked.
096                        Platform.runLater(() -> {
097                                try {
098                                        System.out.println("\nHW2 Lesson Testing Automation");
099                                        if (restartFile.exists()) testRestart();
100                                        else runTests();
101                                } catch (Exception e) {
102                                        numFailed++;
103                                        e.printStackTrace();
104                                } finally {
105                                        System.out.println("\nNumber of tests passed: " + numPassed);
106                                        System.out.println("Number of tests failed: " + numFailed);
107                                        FoundationsMain.database.closeConnection();
108                                        Platform.exit();
109                                        System.exit(numFailed == 0 ? 0 : 1);
110                                }
111                        });
112                } catch (Exception e) {
113                        e.printStackTrace();
114                        Platform.exit();
115                        System.exit(1);
116                }
117        }
118        /**
119         * Exercises cases 1-5 and 7-20, then saves case 6's restart fixture.
120         * @throws Exception if a database, evidence, or marker operation fails
121         */
122        private static void runTests() throws Exception {
123                // Clear only the separate test database so list counts are repeatable.
124                for (Lesson lesson : ModelLessons.readLessons(testOwnerId).getLessons())
125                        ModelLessons.deleteLesson(lesson.getId());
126                ViewLessons.refreshList();
127
128                testButtons();
129                // CASE 01: A contributor can create multiple lessons with distinct persistent IDs.
130                fields(title, problem, solution, experience);
131                ControllerLessons.createLesson();
132                int firstId = ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().get(0).getId();
133                fields("Organizing diagrams", problem, solution, "");
134                ControllerLessons.createLesson();
135                int secondId = ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().get(1).getId();
136                
137                performTestCase(1, "Create two lessons with different IDs",
138                                firstId != secondId && ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size() == 2);
139                select(firstId);
140                ControllerLessons.readLesson();
141                
142                // CASE 02: Reading must restore all four stored fields, not just the list title.
143                performTestCase(2, "Read all stored fields", formMatches(title, problem, solution, experience));
144                capture("01-created-and-read");
145                // CASE 03: Editing one lesson must retain its identity and preserve its neighbor.
146                fields("Updated diagrams", "Need four CRUD diagrams.", "Use one diagram per operation.", experience);
147                ControllerLessons.updateLesson();
148                Lesson updated = ModelLessons.readLesson(firstId);
149                
150                performTestCase(3, "Update fields, keep ID and other lesson",
151                                updated.getId() == firstId && updated.getTitle().equals("Updated diagrams")
152                                && updated.getProblem().equals("Need four CRUD diagrams.")
153                                && updated.getSolution().equals("Use one diagram per operation.")
154                                && ModelLessons.readLesson(secondId).getTitle().equals("Organizing diagrams"));
155                // CASE 04: Optional experience can be added, replaced, and cleared independently.
156                for (String text : new String[] {experience, "The diagrams took 30 minutes.", ""}) {
157                        select(firstId);
158                        ViewLessons.text_Experience.setText(text);
159                        ControllerLessons.updateLesson();
160                        performTestCase(4, "Save experience: " + (text.isEmpty() ? "blank" : text),
161                                        ModelLessons.readLesson(firstId).getExperience().equals(text));
162                }
163                // CASE 05: Persistent deletion must affect only the chosen ID.
164                select(secondId);
165                ControllerLessons.deleteLesson();
166                
167                performTestCase(5, "Delete selected lesson only",
168                                ModelLessons.readLesson(secondId) == null && ModelLessons.readLesson(firstId) != null
169                                && ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size() == 1);
170
171                // CASE 07: Collection CRUD must preserve the entries that were not targeted.
172                LessonList list = new LessonList();
173                list.addLesson(new Lesson(1, testOwnerId, title, problem, solution, ""));
174                list.addLesson(new Lesson(2, testOwnerId, "Other lesson", problem, solution, ""));
175                performTestCase(7, "Add and read a list entry", list.getLesson(1).getTitle().equals(title));
176                performTestCase(7, "Update chosen list entry", list.updateLesson(new Lesson(1, testOwnerId, "Changed", problem, solution, ""))
177                                && list.getLesson(1).getTitle().equals("Changed") && list.getLesson(2).getTitle().equals("Other lesson"));
178                performTestCase(7, "Remove chosen list entry", list.removeLesson(1)
179                                && list.getLesson(1) == null && list.getLesson(2) != null);
180
181                // CASE 10: Both empty and whitespace-only required fields must be rejected.
182                for (String blank : new String[] {"", "   "}) {
183                        testCreateError(10, blank, problem, solution, "", titleError);
184                        testCreateError(10, title, blank, solution, "", problemError);
185                        testCreateError(10, title, problem, blank, "", solutionError);
186                }
187                // CASE 11: Exact lower and upper required-field boundaries are inclusive.
188                testValid(11, "A", "B", "C", "");
189                testValid(11, "T".repeat(100), "P".repeat(2000), "S".repeat(2000), "");
190                // CASE 12: One character above each maximum must fail without inserting a row.
191                testCreateError(12, "T".repeat(101), problem, solution, "", titleError);
192                testCreateError(12, title, "P".repeat(2001), solution, "", problemError);
193                testCreateError(12, title, problem, "S".repeat(2001), "", solutionError);
194                // CASE 13: Experience is optional, but its nonblank content has a length limit.
195                testValid(13, title, problem, solution, "");
196                testValid(13, title, problem, solution, "E".repeat(2000));
197                testCreateError(13, title, problem, solution, "E".repeat(2001), experienceError);
198
199                // CASE 14: Compare full database snapshots to detect partial writes after rejection.
200                for (String[] invalid : new String[][] {
201                                {"", problem, solution, "", titleError},
202                                {"T".repeat(101), problem, solution, "", titleError},
203                                {title, "", solution, "", problemError},
204                                {title, "P".repeat(2001), solution, "", problemError},
205                                {title, problem, "", "", solutionError},
206                                {title, problem, "S".repeat(2001), "", solutionError},
207                                {title, problem, solution, "E".repeat(2001), experienceError}}) {
208                        select(firstId);
209                        Lesson before = ModelLessons.readLesson(firstId);
210                        fields(invalid[0], invalid[1], invalid[2], invalid[3]);
211                        testError(14, ControllerLessons::updateLesson, invalid[4]);
212                        Lesson after = ModelLessons.readLesson(firstId);
213                        performTestCase(14, "Invalid edit preserves all saved fields", sameLesson(before, after));
214                }
215                // CASE 15: No selection and a stale selected ID must both yield a helpful error.
216                ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getSelectionModel().clearSelection();
217                testError(15, ControllerLessons::readLesson, selectionError);
218                testError(15, ControllerLessons::updateLesson, selectionError);
219                testError(15, ControllerLessons::deleteLesson, selectionError);
220                // this keeps an entry displayed while deleting its record to reproduce a stale selection
221                select(firstId);
222                ModelLessons.deleteLesson(firstId);
223                testError(15, ControllerLessons::readLesson, selectionError);
224                testError(15, ControllerLessons::updateLesson, selectionError);
225                testError(15, ControllerLessons::deleteLesson, selectionError);
226                for (Lesson lesson : ModelLessons.readLessons(testOwnerId).getLessons())
227                        ModelLessons.deleteLesson(lesson.getId());
228                ViewLessons.refreshList();
229                // CASE 08: Empty, singleton, and generated large lists must have exact counts.
230                performTestCase(8, "Empty list displays No lessons", ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().isEmpty()
231                                && ((Label) ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getPlaceholder()).getText().equals("No Lessons"));
232                capture("03-empty-list");
233                // CASE 09: A subset changes the display without deleting persistent lessons.
234                ControllerLessons.showSelectedLessons();
235                performTestCase(9, "Empty subset", ViewLessons.displayedLessons.getLessons().isEmpty());
236                fields(title, problem, solution, "");
237                ControllerLessons.createLesson();
238                int savedId = ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().get(0).getId();
239                performTestCase(8, "List with one lesson", ModelLessons.readLessons(testOwnerId).getLessons().size() == 1);
240                select(savedId);
241                ControllerLessons.showSelectedLessons();
242                performTestCase(9, "Subset with one lesson", ViewLessons.displayedLessons.getLessons().size() == 1);
243                select(savedId);
244                ControllerLessons.removeFromSubset();
245                performTestCase(9, "Subset removal preserves database record",
246                                ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().isEmpty() && ModelLessons.readLesson(savedId) != null);
247                // the generated variations of the sample test a large list without typing 1,000 forms
248                for (int i = 1; i < 1000; i++)
249                        ModelLessons.createLesson(new Lesson(0, testOwnerId, "CRUD diagram lesson " + i, problem, solution, ""));
250                ViewLessons.refreshList();
251                performTestCase(8, "All 1,000 entries can be read", ModelLessons.readLessons(testOwnerId).getLessons().size() == 1000
252                                && ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size() == 1000);
253                ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getSelectionModel().selectAll();
254                ControllerLessons.showSelectedLessons();
255                performTestCase(9, "Subset with 1,000 lessons", ViewLessons.displayedLessons.getLessons().size() == 1000);
256                select(savedId);
257                ControllerLessons.removeFromSubset();
258                performTestCase(9, "Large subset removal preserves database record",
259                                ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size() == 999 && ModelLessons.readLesson(savedId) != null);
260                capture("04-large-subset");
261                testContributorLists();
262                testListSearch();
263                testEntityPersistence();
264                testDatabaseErrors();
265                ContributorStoryTests.run();
266                ViewLessons.refreshList();
267                select(savedId);
268                ViewLessons.text_Title.setText("Saved after restart");
269                ControllerLessons.updateLesson();
270                int deletedId = ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().get(999).getId();
271                select(deletedId);
272                ControllerLessons.deleteLesson();
273                try (PrintWriter output = new PrintWriter(restartFile)) {
274                        output.println(savedId);
275                        output.println(deletedId);
276                }
277                System.out.println("\nTest 6: Run this class again to check a separate execution.");
278        }
279        /**
280         * Verifies case 6 in a fresh process using IDs recorded by the first execution.
281         * @throws Exception if database access or reading the marker fails
282         */
283        private static void testRestart() throws Exception {
284                // CASE 06: A new JVM must read saved data, not a previous process's cached list.
285                try (Scanner input = new Scanner(restartFile)) {
286                        int savedId = input.nextInt();
287                        int deletedId = input.nextInt();
288                        Lesson saved = ModelLessons.readLesson(savedId);
289                        performTestCase(6, "Created and edited lesson survives a separate execution", saved != null
290                                        && saved.getId() == savedId && saved.getTitle().equals("Saved after restart")
291                                        && saved.getProblem().equals(problem) && saved.getSolution().equals(solution)
292                                        && saved.getExperience().isEmpty());
293                        performTestCase(6, "Deleted lesson stays deleted", ModelLessons.readLesson(deletedId) == null);
294                        performTestCase(6, "All remaining lessons survive", ModelLessons.readLessons(testOwnerId).getLessons().size() == 999);
295                        select(savedId);
296                        capture("05-after-restart");
297                }
298                if (!restartFile.delete()) System.out.println("Could not remove the restart test marker.");
299                ContributorStoryTests.testRestartRestoresState();
300                ContributorStoryTests.testRestartKeepsRestrictions();
301        }

321        /**
322         * Checks the actual validation dialog and verifies no record was added.

337        /**
338         * Reads and dismisses a real modal error dialog in its nested JavaFX event loop.
339         * @param number requirement case number
340         * @param action controller action expected to show an error
341         * @param expected exact expected error content
342         */
343        private static void testError(int number, Runnable action, String expected) {
344                actualError = "";
345                // showAndWait processes this queued action and it reads the real dialog before it dismisses it
346                Platform.runLater(() -> {
347                        for (Window window : Window.getWindows().toArray(new Window[0])) {
348                                if (window.getScene() != null && window.getScene().getRoot() instanceof DialogPane) {
349                                        DialogPane pane = (DialogPane) window.getScene().getRoot();
350                                        actualError = pane.getContentText();
351                                        if (evidenceDirectory != null && !errorCaptured) {
352                                                try {
353                                                        LessonTestEvidence.capture(pane, evidenceDirectory.resolve("02-validation-error.png"));
354                                                        errorCaptured = true;
355                                                } catch (Exception failure) {
356                                                        numFailed++;
357                                                        failure.printStackTrace();
358                                                }
359                                        }
360                                        pane.lookupButton(ButtonType.OK).fireEvent(new javafx.event.ActionEvent());
361                                }
362                        }
363                });
364                action.run();
365                performTestCase(number, "Helpful error: " + expected, actualError.equals(expected));
366                System.out.println("Actual error: " + actualError);
367        }
368        /** @param id ID to select in the currently displayed list */
369        private static void select(int id) {
370                ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getSelectionModel().clearSelection();
371                for (Lesson lesson : ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems()) {
372                        if (lesson.getId() == id) {
373                                ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getSelectionModel().select(lesson);
374                                return;
375                        }
376                }
377        }

385        private static void fields(String t, String p, String s, String e) {

391        /**
392         * Compares every visible field with expected stored text.
393         * @param t expected title
394         * @param p expected problem
395         * @param s expected solution
396         * @param e expected experience
397         * @return whether all four fields match
398         */
399        private static boolean formMatches(String t, String p, String s, String e) {
400                return ViewLessons.text_Title.getText().equals(t) && ViewLessons.text_Problem.getText().equals(p)
401                                && ViewLessons.text_Solution.getText().equals(s) && ViewLessons.text_Experience.getText().equals(e);
402        }
403        /**
404         * Compares persisted identity, ownership, and text after a rejected edit.
405         * @param a snapshot before the attempted edit
406         * @param b snapshot after the attempted edit
407         * @return whether the complete stored record is unchanged
408         */
409        private static boolean sameLesson(Lesson a, Lesson b) {
410                return a != null && b != null && a.getOwnerId() == b.getOwnerId()
411                                && a.getId() == b.getId() && a.getTitle().equals(b.getTitle()) && a.getProblem().equals(b.getProblem())
412                                && a.getSolution().equals(b.getSolution()) && a.getExperience().equals(b.getExperience());
413        }
414        /**
415         * Reports one assertion; multiple assertions may belong to the same case.
416         * @param number requirement case number
417         * @param description assertion description
418         * @param passed whether the observed result met the expectation
419         */
420        private static void performTestCase(int number, String description, boolean passed) {
421                System.out.println("\nTest case " + number + ": " + description);
422                if (passed) {
423                        System.out.println("Success");
424                        numPassed++;
425                } else {
426                        System.out.println("Failure");
427                        numFailed++;
428                }
429        }

446                // CASE 16: An independent owner fixture detects accidental unfiltered list reads.

458        /** Checks duplicate IDs, missing IDs, defensive list copies, and keyword subsets (case 17). */
459        private static void testListSearch() {
460                // CASE 17: Exercise missing IDs, duplicate IDs, copy isolation, and all search fields.
461                LessonList list = new LessonList();
462                list.addLesson(new Lesson(1, testOwnerId, "Alpha", "ProblemToken", "SolutionToken", "ExperienceToken"));
463                list.addLesson(new Lesson(1, testOwnerId, "Duplicate", "", "", ""));
464                list.addLesson(new Lesson(2, testOwnerId, "Beta", "Other", "Other", ""));
465                performTestCase(17, "Duplicate ID is ignored", list.getLessons().size() == 2 && list.getLesson(1).getTitle().equals("Alpha"));
466                performTestCase(17, "Missing IDs return null or false", list.getLesson(99) == null
467                                && !list.updateLesson(new Lesson(99, testOwnerId, "Absent", "", "", "")) && !list.removeLesson(99));
468                list.getLessons().clear();
469                performTestCase(17, "Changing returned list preserves original", list.getLessons().size() == 2);
470                for (String keyword : new String[] {" ALPHA ", "problemtoken", "solutiontoken", "experiencetoken"}) {
471                        LessonList subset = list.searchByKeyword(keyword);
472                        performTestCase(17, "Keyword matches field: " + keyword.trim(),
473                                        subset.getLessons().size() == 1 && subset.getLesson(1) != null && list.getLessons().size() == 2);
474                }
475                performTestCase(17, "Absent keyword yields empty subset", list.searchByKeyword("missing").getLessons().isEmpty());
476                performTestCase(17, "Blank and null keywords match all", list.searchByKeyword("").getLessons().size() == 2
477                                && list.searchByKeyword(null).getLessons().size() == 2);
478        }

480        /**
481         * Exercises actual button handlers, including subset restoration and Back (case 18).
482         * @throws Exception if database access fails
483         */
484        private static void testButtons() throws Exception {
485                // CASE 18: Fire installed button handlers so broken MVC bindings cannot pass silently.
486                fields(title, problem, solution, experience);
487                fireButton("Create");
488                performTestCase(18, "Create button saves a lesson", ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size() == 1);
489                int lessonId = ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().get(0).getId();
490                select(lessonId);
491                fields("", "", "", "");
492                fireButton("Read");
493                performTestCase(18, "Read button restores every field", formMatches(title, problem, solution, experience));
494                ViewLessons.text_Title.setText("Button update");
495                fireButton("Update");
496                performTestCase(18, "Update button saves the edited title", ModelLessons.readLesson(lessonId).getTitle().equals("Button update"));
497                select(lessonId);
498                fireButton("Show selected");
499                performTestCase(18, "Show selected button clears the form", ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size() == 1
500                                && formMatches("", "", "", ""));
501                select(lessonId);
502                fireButton("Remove from subset");
503                performTestCase(18, "Remove button hides without deleting", ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().isEmpty()
504                                && ModelLessons.readLesson(lessonId) != null);
505                fireButton("Show all");
506                performTestCase(18, "Show all button restores the lesson", ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size() == 1);
507                select(lessonId);
508                fireButton("Delete");
509                performTestCase(18, "Delete button removes the saved record", ModelLessons.readLesson(lessonId) == null
510                                && ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().isEmpty());
511                javafx.scene.Scene lessonScene = ViewLessons.theStage.getScene();
512                fireButton("Back");
513                performTestCase(18, "Back button restores scene and title", ViewLessons.theStage.getScene() == ViewLessons.theHomeScene
514                                && ViewLessons.theStage.getTitle().equals("Contributor test home"));
515                ViewLessons.theStage.setScene(lessonScene);
516                ViewLessons.theStage.setTitle("CSE 360: Lessons Learned");
517        }

519        /**
520         * Fires a visible button through its installed action handler.
521         * @param caption exact button text to find
522         * @throws IllegalStateException if the expected control is absent
523         */
524        private static void fireButton(String caption) {
525                ViewLessons.theStage.getScene().getRoot().applyCss();
526                for (javafx.scene.Node node : ViewLessons.theStage.getScene().getRoot().lookupAll(".button")) {
527                        if (node instanceof javafx.scene.control.Button button && button.getText().equals(caption)) {
528                                button.fire();
529                                return;
530                        }
531                }
532                throw new IllegalStateException("Missing button: " + caption);
533        }

535        /**
536         * Checks Task 3's entity validation and persistence without going through the MVC controller.
537         * @throws Exception if the entity/database fixture fails
538         */
539        private static void testEntityPersistence() throws Exception {
540                // CASE 19: The entity itself must guard invalid writes, even without GUI validation.
541                int originalCount = ModelLessons.readLessons(testOwnerId).getLessons().size();
542                for (Lesson invalid : new Lesson[] {
543                                new Lesson(0, testOwnerId, null, problem, solution, null),
544                                new Lesson(0, testOwnerId, title, null, solution, ""),
545                                new Lesson(0, testOwnerId, title, problem, null, ""),
546                                new Lesson(0, testOwnerId, "T".repeat(101), problem, solution, ""),
547                                new Lesson(0, testOwnerId, title, "P".repeat(2001), solution, ""),
548                                new Lesson(0, testOwnerId, title, problem, "S".repeat(2001), ""),
549                                new Lesson(0, testOwnerId, title, problem, solution, "E".repeat(2001))}) {
550                        performTestCase(19, "Entity rejects invalid create without inserting",
551                                        !invalid.isValid() && invalid.create(FoundationsMain.database) == -1
552                                        && ModelLessons.readLessons(testOwnerId).getLessons().size() == originalCount);
553                }
554                Lesson entity = new Lesson(0, testOwnerId, "  Entity title  ", " Problem ", " Solution ", null);
555                int entityId = entity.create(FoundationsMain.database);
556                Lesson stored = Lesson.read(FoundationsMain.database, entityId);
557                performTestCase(19, "Entity create trims text, normalizes null experience, assigns ID",
558                                entityId > 0 && entity.getId() == entityId && stored != null
559                                && stored.getTitle().equals("Entity title") && stored.getProblem().equals("Problem")
560                                && stored.getSolution().equals("Solution") && stored.getExperience().isEmpty());
561                entity.setTitle("   ");
562                performTestCase(19, "Entity rejects invalid update and preserves stored snapshot",
563                                !entity.update(FoundationsMain.database) && sameLesson(stored, Lesson.read(FoundationsMain.database, entityId)));
564                entity.setTitle(" Updated entity ");
565                entity.setProblem(" Updated problem ");
566                entity.setSolution(" Updated solution ");
567                entity.setExperience(" Updated experience ");
568                performTestCase(19, "Entity update persists normalized fields and unchanged identity",
569                                entity.update(FoundationsMain.database) && sameLesson(entity, Lesson.read(FoundationsMain.database, entityId)));
570                LessonList ownLessons = LessonList.readLessons(FoundationsMain.database, testOwnerId);
571                LessonList allLessons = LessonList.readAllLessons(FoundationsMain.database);
572                performTestCase(19, "Persistent list APIs include the newly created entity",
573                                ownLessons.getLesson(entityId) != null && allLessons.getLesson(entityId) != null
574                                && ownLessons.getLessons().size() == originalCount + 1);
575                performTestCase(19, "Entity delete removes stored row and repeated delete returns false",
576                                entity.delete(FoundationsMain.database) && Lesson.read(FoundationsMain.database, entityId) == null
577                                && !entity.delete(FoundationsMain.database));
578                ViewLessons.refreshList();
579        }

581        /**
582         * Checks Task 4's helpful database error dialogs and recovery after reconnection.
583         * @throws Exception if preparing or restoring the database connection fails
584         */
585        private static void testDatabaseErrors() throws Exception {
586                // CASE 20: Close only the isolated connection to force genuine SQL failures.
587                Lesson selected = ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().get(0);
588                select(selected.getId());
589                int displayedCount = ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size();
590                FoundationsMain.database.closeConnection();
591                try {
592                        testError(20, ControllerLessons::createLesson, "Could not save the lesson. Please try again.");
593                        testError(20, ControllerLessons::readLesson, "Could not read the lesson. Please try again.");
594                        testError(20, ControllerLessons::updateLesson, "Could not update the lesson. Please try again.");
595                        testError(20, ControllerLessons::deleteLesson, "Could not delete the lesson. Please try again.");
596                        testError(20, ViewLessons::refreshList, "Could not load lessons. Please try again.");
597                        performTestCase(20, "Failed list read preserves visible rows", ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size() == displayedCount);
598                } finally {
599                        FoundationsMain.database.connectToDatabase();
600                        ViewLessons.refreshList();
601                }
602                performTestCase(20, "Reconnection restores unchanged stored fields", sameLesson(selected, ModelLessons.readLesson(selected.getId()))
603                                && ViewLessons.list_Lessons.getItems().size() == displayedCount);
604        }
